references.shows: The four-top-action model at lower left shows a tall compact U, narrow valve branches and an S-shaped leadpipe.
Maker reference for the chosen instrument form and proportions.

silhouette: Slender upright bell with a tall, narrow U-shaped wrap and tightly nested valve slides.
features: Upright bell with narrower rim than the tuba
Tall outer bow and rounded left riser frame the valve group.
Four top-action pistons in a straight row
Slender S-shaped leadpipe and short nested slides
iconFeatures: Tall upright bell and rounded U-shaped body.
Curved leadpipe entering four closely spaced pistons.
avoid: Overlapping tubes that hide the principal bends
Detached or offset mouthpiece and bell
notes: The neutral catalogue photo of the YEP-321S guides the silhouette and visible tube routing. The illustration simplifies overlapping plumbing from the side.

geometry.view: Neutral catalogue side view in playing orientation
geometry.proportions: The slim upright wrap supports a bell approximately two fifths of the full height in width. The four pistons sit high within the narrower side of the wrap.
geometry.partLayout: Carry the right bell throat down through the lower bow and up into the rounded left riser. Bring the S-shaped leadpipe in from the right and tuck the four slide returns into their casings.

documentedDimensions.value: 280 mm bell diameter; 14.5 mm bore at pistons 1–3 and 15.5 mm at piston 4.
